Rank 2 melee technique
Ki Cost: 12 ki
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Melee
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
A stomach shot designed to knock the wind out of an
opponent.
Make a Combo attack roll dealing your unarmed
strike + 2d10 damage on a hit and the target cannot
take reactions until the start of their next turn.
